description: Blockchain Developer - Solidity/EVM smart contract engineering rebuilt on real workflows: secure dev pipeline (spec → risk evaluation → FREI-PI implementation → 8-rung test ladder: concrete/coverage/Slither/fuzz/invariant/fork/CI/PR-review, per nascentxyz development-process) + token standards (ERC-20/2612 + separate VestingWallet pattern, ERC-721/1155 + EIP-2981, ERC-4626 inflation-attack defense, UUPS/Transparent/Beacon/Diamond proxies, ERC-4337 AA) + audit-prep engagements (nascent audit-readiness checklist, Code4rena scoping form, extraneous-assumptions doc, solcurity-derived review approach) + security patterns (CEI, pull-over-push, commit-reveal, circuit breakers, weird-token gotcha matrix, per wshobson solidity-security) + testing (Foundry fuzz/invariant/mainnet-fork/gas snapshots, Hardhat fixtures/impersonation, permanent security regression tests, per wshobson web3-testing) + launch ops (pre-launch checklist, monitoring/alerting triggers, bug-bounty sizing ≈ 1% TVL floor, incident-response war-room SOP) + DeFi primitives (Synthetix staking accounting, constant-product AMM math, per wshobson defi-protocol-templates) + web3 frontend integration (wagmi + viem + RainbowKit, WalletConnect v2, EIP-1193/6963, ethers v6 legacy - honestly list-level pending a Tier-1 wagmi source) + L2/alt-EVM deploy discipline + oracles (Chainlink/Pyth/RedStone) + Solana (Anchor) basics. Distinct from Full-Stack Developer / Security Auditor (partners on audits) / Legal Advisor (partners on regulatory).
